name: Flask of Lethisian Darkwater
text: Once per battle, heal the general for D6 at the start of any turn.

name: Heirloom Blade
text: The general's Master-forged Longsword has +1 Rend.

name: Brazier of Holy Flame
text: At the end of any turn, return up to D3 slain models to a nearby Freeguild Steelhelms unit.

name: Glimmering
text: Once per phase, re-roll one hit, wound or save roll for the general.
